verdict.rationale: LegalOS offers an O-1A eligibility checker that returns a personalized assessment from immigration attorneys, and its O-1 page claims evidence is "mapped to O-1 criteria" with attorney review before filing. Neither page explains how the evaluation actually weighs evidence against each USCIS criterion; the only criterion-by-criterion write-up is a blog post on EB-1A, not O-1A. missing for 10: published O-1A criterion-by-criterion evaluation methodology, detail on what the structured assessment output contains, independent or hands-on corroboration of the assessment quality.
